access_note: Public metadata and available JSON dictionaries verified. Operational file access and row completeness were not tested.
description: ONS publishes hourly turbinable spilled-energy estimates with hydropower generation, available capacity, turbine and spill flows, productivity and generation headroom. Plant and reservoir identifiers locate each series within the interconnected electricity system. These values support studies of hydropower dispatch and unused generation potential. Timestamps denote the start of the hour. The dictionary labels the main energy-rate fields in average megawatts; these must not be confused with the MWh quantities in the separate classified-spill product. Coverage is individual reservoirs in Brazil. The catalogue lists CSV, Excel and Parquet files; files are free under the provider's CC-BY terms, with no version specified. ONS requires attribution and disclosure of changes. Data contents were not downloaded; completeness is unknown, and published values may be revised. Related ONS generation-by-plant data provide a comparison series.

discovery_routes.query: Existing ONS entries -> complete 85-package catalogue -> exact and fuzzy duplicate review -> provider dictionaries.
